versions.changelog:
guaikei-xhs-blogger-insights v1.0.0

- Initial release for obtaining real interaction statistics (likes, comments, favorites) of public Xiaohongshu (小红书) creator posts and single notes.
- Supports keyword search, single note details, comment retrieval, and creator's public works fetching, all via command-line scripts.
- Helps users evaluate true engagement quality for KOL filtering, data authenticity verification, and partnership decisions.
- Provides structured JSON output; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for authentication.
- Not intended for follower estimation or access to private/backend data.
